name: sHATE staking share inflation
summary: The HATE staking contract credited sHATE on the pre-fee amount of the fee-on-transfer HATE token, so a flash-swapped stake/unstake cycle returned more HATE than went in and the surplus was sold into the HATE/ETH pair.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
